title: Contact – custom 3D printing in Sofia
subtitle: Phone, Viber, email or the enquiry form
intro: Looking for custom 3D printing? We make prototypes, functional parts, gifts and small batches – from a ready 3D model or just an idea. The quickest way to reach us is by phone or Viber, but you can also email us or use the form below. We answer enquiries in English and Bulgarian.

info.heading: Get in touch
info.lead: We reply quickly — choose whichever way suits you best.
info.viberTooltip: Click for a direct chat on Viber
info.instagramTooltip: Follow us on Instagram for photos of our projects
info.tiktokTooltip: Watch videos of our 3D printing projects on TikTok
info.youtubeTooltip: See how we work on our YouTube channel

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.text: In Sofia we hand over finished orders in person or by city courier – arranged by phone or message. Anywhere else in Bulgaria we ship with Econt or Speedy. Delivery is free anywhere in Bulgaria for orders over €{freeOver}.

quote.title: A quote with our first reply
quote.text: If you already have a model, tell us the colour, size and deadline you want – and you'll get a quote with our very first reply.
